dedup_layer.in_flight_rule: same method + endpoint + same params reuse one promise
dedup_layer.overflow_behavior: queue new requests unless an identical in-flight promise exists
dedup_layer.mutation_behavior: non-GET requests clear the memory cache before dispatch
dedup_layer.unauthorized_behavior: 401 responses clear the memory cache and dispatch the existing auth unauthorized event
